topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I arrived home, and there it was, a small piece of paper on my windshield where my car had been parked just hours before. A tow notice. It took a moment, but I didn’t let the frustration settle. I knew the drill, called the number, and explained the situation with a calm that surprised even me. Turns out, some neighbor reported it as abandoned. I couldn’t help but chuckle at the misunderstanding. After a quick verification of ownership and a nominal fee, they had my car back to me. I even managed to get it towed back to my driveway. A bit of paperwork and a minor inconvenience, but it’s all sorted now. Handling it smoothly made the whole situation a non-event.
